Messages.Author: Saul Resnikoff
Messages.Body:
The superior version of this card says "this reacting vampire may steal
1 blood from the acting minion as a strike if combat begins." Can you:

1) Use that strike every round of the combat?

2) Assuming "no" for #1, use that strike in the 2nd round of combat
after using some other strike (a gun, for instance) in the first round?

We figured you get the choice only in the first round, and if you don't
use it then, it's lost, but the card isn't specific enough, so we're
asking.

-Saul Resnikoff
da...@rmi.net

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Saul Resnikoff wrote:
>
> The superior version of this card says "this reacting vampire may steal
> 1 blood from the acting minion as a strike if combat begins." Can you:
>
> 1) Use that strike every round of the combat?

No.

> 2) Assuming "no" for #1, use that strike in the 2nd round of combat
> after using some other strike (a gun, for instance) in the first round?

Yes.

> We figured you get the choice only in the first round, and if you don't
> use it then, it's lost, but the card isn't specific enough, so we're
> asking.

It allows you to use the "steal 1 blood" strike once during the
resulting combat.
